snippet.title: Oh good heavens,  the loot! || OUTCLAW Devlog 01
snippet.description:
Welcome to the first Moss Monkey OUTCLAW devlog! Today we have Louis (Mr. Mophead himself) take us through an early blockout of the Parliament of Owls level for our indie game. Learn his thought processes about level design, and how you can improve yours!
☆
Play the OUTCLAW demo here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3165050/OUTCLAW/
Follow along our journey here: https://linktr.ee/mossmonkeygames

☆

Sources:
Images from: Unsplash
